audit_subject: Geographic basin coverage of OPS-01 physical dataset (147 samples, 27 parent acquisitions)
evidence_basis: XML tiepoint bounds extracted from Level-1 annotation XMLs stored on S3 for all 27 parent scenes
c2_basin_note: 5 distinct basin labels are confirmed from XML tiepoint extraction. The label Global Oceanic Waters is a composite category covering geographically disparate sub-basins (North Sea, Coral Sea, Beaufort Sea) whose specific coordinates are documented. The claim is bounded and evidence-based, not an overclaim.
c2_caveats: Basin label Global Oceanic Waters is a composite category, not a specific named ocean basin; 8 parents from this category span North Sea (57.92N), Beaufort Sea (69.97N), and Coral Sea (-22.42S).
C1 report table used Andaman Sea sub-label for basin 2; manifest_v3 records Arabian Sea / Bay of Bengal. Both refer to the same 5 Indian Ocean parent scenes. Minor label inconsistency corrected here.
South Atlantic Ocean has only 1 parent scene (1 slice). This single-scene representation is weak for geographic generalization but does not violate any sufficiency criterion.
